summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of AI session management and usage limits. All 13 tests pass. Session endpoints (start, message, get, delete), multi-turn context, cross-user protection (403), daily limits (429), and AI endpoints (parse-strategy, explain, analyze-risk, ai/usage) all work correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/v1/session/start creates session and returns session_id (UUID format)
POST /api/v1/session/{session_id}/message sends message and gets AI response (not truncated)
Multi-turn context: send 4 messages, AI response includes context from previous messages
GET /api/v1/session/{session_id} returns full session with all messages
DELETE /api/v1/session/{session_id} deletes session (verified with 404 on subsequent GET)
Cross-user session access returns 403 (GET, POST message, DELETE all blocked)
Daily limit enforcement: nl_parser at 20 calls returns 429 with 'daily limit' message
POST /api/v1/parse-strategy works with AI (returns parsed JSON)
POST /api/v1/explain works with AI (returns answer field)
POST /api/v1/analyze-risk works with AI (returns warnings list)
GET /api/v1/ai/usage returns per-role usage stats with correct limits (nl_parser=20, explainer=10, risk_analyzer=10, session_chat=30)
seed_data_creation: Test sessions created during tests, cleaned up via pytest fixture
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI session management fully implemented. Endpoints: POST /session/start, POST /session/{id}/message, GET /session/{id}, DELETE /session/{id}. Daily limits configured in ai_sessions.py AI_CONFIG: nl_parser=20, explainer=10, risk_analyzer=10, session_chat=30. GPT-5.2 temperature must be 1. Context window: last 6 messages, 500 token budget. MongoDB conversation_sessions has TTL 24h index on updated_at. All AI calls use real OpenAI GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM key (no mocking).
